mechanism: Oral contraceptives may increase rizatriptan exposure through altered hepatic metabolism and increased serotonergic effects; rizatriptan is a 5-HT1B/1D agonist with potential for additive vasoconstriction in estrogen-containing formulations.
action: Monitor for increased triptan side effects (chest tightness, palpitations, dizziness); consider alternative migraine therapy or lowest effective rizatriptan dose; counsel patients on warning signs of vasospastic complications.
